_comment: Where the AutoCode review's Apply leaves one proposal: read by tests/test_recut_contract.py (the server's recut_target, through RecutRequest and the stored-line reading) and frontend/src/utils/recut.test.ts (outcomeZone, through the dialog's snapping). `stored` is the job's two applied_* columns as stored (null: never stored; drifted floats as an earlier build wrote them); `lines` the slider positions sent; `expected` the zone after Apply. docs/design-autocode-landing-plan.md Phase 2: D2, D26, D41.

cases.name: pending above the accept line, lines unmoved: accepted (D41)
pending in the band, lines unmoved: tentative
pending below the exclude line, lines unmoved: excluded (D41)
pending exactly on the exclude line: tentative
pending exactly on the accept line: accepted
threshold acceptance below the line, lines unmoved: stays (D26)
threshold acceptance under a raised accept line: tentative
threshold acceptance still above the raised line: accepted
threshold exclusion above a lowered exclude line: tentative
a decision with no record of who made it moves like a threshold one
never cut: pending on the accept line is accepted
never cut: a decision stays, whatever its zone
drifted stored lines read as their labels
drifted stored lines, unmoved: a decision on the line stays
drifted new lines are snapped before comparing
one line stored: the other is the default
